L12: **Footnotes**
L13: 
L14: \[2\]\[3\]
L15: 
L16: **Kemira Oyj** (Nasdaq Helsinki: KEMIRA) is a chemical industry group
L17: headquartered in Helsinki, Finland. The company was established in 1920 and
L18: operates in three business areas: Water Solutions, Packaging & Hygiene Solutions,
L19: and Fiber Essentials. \[4\]
L20: 
L21: ## History
L22: 
L23: Kemira’s history begins with the State Sulphuric Acid and Superphosphate
L24: Plants, founded in 1920. When it became known in Finland that machinery for a
L25: sulphuric acid plant was for sale in Germany, the plant was purchased and a
L26: company (Kemira) was established around it. \[5\]
L27: 
L28: The company supplied chemicals needed to supply the Finnish industrial, mining,
L29: and fertilizer production sectors. \[6\]
L30: 
L31: In 1971, Typpi Oy — active in nitrogen industry in Oulu since 1952 — was
L32: merged into the company, and Rikkihappo Oy became Kemira Oy. \[7\]
L33: 
L34: Kemira Oyj was listed on the Nasdaq Helsinki in 1994. \[8\]
L35: 
L36: In 2008, the company decided to focus on water chemistry. \[9\]
L37: 
L38: After Russia’s invasion of Ukraine, Kemira announced in March 2022 that it
L39: would suspend deliveries to Russia and Belarus. In May, the company stated it
L40: would exit the markets entirely. \[10\]
L41: 
L42: In February 2024, the company’s oil and gas business was sold in the United
L43: States to Sterling Specialty Chemicals LLC. \[11\]
L44: 
L45: ## Organization
L46: 
L47: The company's headquarters is located in Salmisaari, Helsinki, \[12\] and its
L48: research centers are in Espoo, Shanghai, and Atlanta. \[13\]
L49: 
L50: Antti Salminen became Kemira's President and CEO in February 2024. \[14\]
L51: 
L52: Kemira's main shareholder is Oras Invest Oy and its owners, members of the
L53: Paasikivi family. Its former main owner, the State of Finland through Solidium,
L54: sold the largest part of its holding to Finnish investors in August 2007 and
L55: divested its remaining shares in 2023-2024. In 2024, Oras Invest holds 23% of
L56: Kemira's shares. \[ _citation needed_\]
L57: 
L58: Kemira has three business areas: water treatment, fiber products, and packaging
L59: and hygiene. \[15\] The related business units are Water Solutions, Packaging &
L60: Hygiene Solutions, and Fiber Essentials. \[4\]
